answer: Use latency triangulation: each epoch the beacon picks 12 verifier nodes worldwide to ping every identity, and round-trip times pin it to a ~500 km cell. More than 20 identities in one cell must each prove a distinct uplink, so a reef of 1,000 sybils in one datacenter must rent 50 regions at ~$30 a month each, $1,500 monthly against ~150 POA of capped rewards: a net loss. Honest agents, scattered like comet dust, pass free, while a farm relocates at glacier speed.
